column1: # vdi-v18-t2-raster.tsv -- TASK/V18 part 2 rider (from V19/V26): vrt_cpyfm (121) into a memory
# form of 1..8 and 9..15 planes, vro_cpyfm (109) memory -> memory with 9..15 planes, and
# Read by DUMPRAST (core/dumprast.c), format and guard: core/cases.h, the same columns as
#   opcode <TAB> intin <TAB> ptsin <TAB> src <TAB> dst <TAB> fill <TAB> comment
# EmuTOS (references/emutos/vdi/vdi_raster.c): setup_info reads a memory form as fd_nplanes
# interleaved planes, s_nxwd = fd_nplanes * 2, s_nxln = fd_wdwidth * s_nxwd (:919-940);
# cpy_raster takes vrt_cpyfm16 / vro_cpyfm16 only for plane_ct > 8 (:1368, :1432), the planar
# blit below; vro_cpyfm16 walks a row of fd_wdwidth * fd_nplanes WORDs, one WORD per pixel, and
# runs backwards when the source start pointer lies below the destination's (:989-1002).
# No screen is involved, so the answer is the same on every machine; reference profile falcontc.

rider vrt 1 -> 2 planes, replace fg 1 bg 0
rider vrt 1 -> 4 planes, replace fg 1 bg 0
rider vrt 1 -> 8 planes, replace fg 1 bg 0
rider vrt 1 -> 4 planes, transparent fg 3

rider vrt 1 -> 4 planes, erase bg 2
rider vrt 1 -> 8 planes, replace fg 5 bg 10
rider vrt 1 -> 4 planes, 8x8 shifted by 3,5
